description:
A swing trader wants to filter out market noise using a 3-Line Break chart. Your task is to set up a new chart for 'AAPL' in NinjaTrader 8 with the following specifications:

1. Chart Type: Line Break (NOT Candlestick)
2. Line Break Count: 3
3. Timeframe/Data: Daily
4. Trend Indicator: SMA (Simple Moving Average) with Period 20 (Overlay)
5. Momentum Indicator: RSI (Relative Strength Index) with Period 14 (Panel 2)

Once the chart is configured correctly with AAPL and both indicators, SAVE the workspace to persist your changes.
